comment: Dr. Wares was fantastic for 309. Weekly quizzes and a low-stakes final. Prepare a presentation about anything you want related to finance. Weekly non-mathy readings. Hardest part was the homework, which she is more than happy to help you with. No complaints and great class!

Dr. Wares is awesome. She was super helpful and accessible throughout the whole semester and loved interacting with students. Her lectures were quick but easy to understand and she is always open to questions. Highly recommend.

Dr. Wares does not overcomplicate the material, and her assessments are very straightforward and easier than the homework. As the material got harder, I don't think I learned the concepts well from her lectures. However, I found that she was very helpful one-on-one if I sought help in those cases.

Dr. Wares is not only one of my favorite professors but also the kindest in entire math department. Her classes are incredibly engaging, filled with humor and energy, making even the toughest math concepts easy to understand. She truly cares about her students, always going above and beyond to support us. Just take her class you won't regret it!

A lot of the course work is based on group work which kind of stinks but Professor Wares is super funny and engaging which makes it worth it. Calc 2 is generally a hard class but her lectures make the material interesting and exciting. Additionally the grading structure makes getting an A very doable if you are willing to be dedicated to the class.

Dr. Wares' class was really easy and minimal studying was required. I took AP Calc BC my junior year in high school and nothing was new. Dr. Wares made the class easy and "quizzes" if thats what you want to call them were the easiest things ever. Tests were also the same difficulty. Definitely TAKE this class with her!

Absolutely love Dr. Wares, she is very caring and knows some good math jokes. She makes it very clear what she expects on assignments and even offers feedback to help students get the best grade possible. Quizzes are based on material learned in the class before so it is always easy to prepare for them. Definitely recommend her class.

Wares class was like bumping into the woman from the AT&T commercial on the beach. A very pleasant surprise, especially for a math class. Learn about the big short, plug some numbers into a calculator, and call it a day. I would mucho recommend.

Great professor. Adapted the class very well to work online. I learned a lot and was challenged. Getting a good great is very obtainable if you put the work in. Very easy to read outside of class for help.
Dr. Wares is great for calc 2. Not hard at all really, there isn't too much work and the work that is there isn't particularly difficult.
Very sweet lady. Not too hard. Not much homework. Not automatic A, but A is definitely doable. Definitely worth taking.
Love Dr. Wares. She has such a positive attitude and is so fun to learn from. I definitely recommend her. Her lectures are really easy to understand. If you put in a bit of effort, pretty easy A.
She's amazing. You won't realize when you learned so much. TAKE HER.
Best Math Teacher ever.! Shes nice and caring. The exams are as easy as they can be. Love her class. Most of the grade is the exams but still easy to end up with an A.

Quizzes every week on the homework material. Knows what she's talking about, but doesn't explain it fully and works very fast through problems. Encourages collaboration and participation in class. Very enthusiastic about calculus.

I love Dr. Wares and would take any class offered by her in a heartbeat! She explains all concepts very clearly and prepares you really well for quizzes and tests. She uses clickers in class to keep you engaged and participating. Dr. Wares is full of life, happy, brilliant, and truly cares about her students. Take her class!!

Professor Wares is the best Math Professor I've had so far. She makes the classes fun and interesting. You can always go and meet her in her office if you have any doubt or if you need anyone to talk to. Her teaching style is awesome so you won't lag behind or not understand something by the end of the week. Just take her class, you'll love it!

Dr. Wares is an amazing professor and human being.  She really cares about her students and is passionate about this subject.  10/10 would recommend taking any class that she teaches.  She is hands down the best calc 2 teacher at UR.

Dr. Wares is my favorite math professor and the reason I am a math major. She is chill and her classes are fun. She does not give much work and her homework is not mandatory, but you can be super-prepared for tests and exams.  I would totally take her again and recommend her to anyone!

Professor Wares is the best math teacher I've had at Richmond. All of her lectures are entertaining and she tries hard to make boring subjects seem interesting. She gives weekly quizzes instead of giving homework but they come almost directly from the book questions. Her quizzes and tests are very fair and she's always there to help you.

Dr. Wares is not only super smart she's also so cute and fun! She constantly makes you feel cared for and loves when you askanswer questions. The material itself isn't that easy but she tries to make it easy to understand and doesn't give too much work.  I would totally take her again and recommend her to anyone!
She's terrific. The class is very straight forward.
Understandable and interesting professor. Always helped when I need it.

The entire class was Powerpoint based, which I did not think was a good thing, considering it's a math class. She can skip through difficult material quickly and assume that everyone understands, which is not usually the case. I wouldn't recommend her unless you like learning from Powerpoints.

She is very humorous and the class is really fun. Lectures are powerpoint based. Sometimes, she taught very fast and it is hard to caught up with her. generally speaking, the moderate effort will guarantee a "A". Almost all the quiz and test come from the homework assignment.

Nope. Don't do it. Don't do if you haven't taken calc. Don't think you'll work hard and fight through because you won't. I took this course at a county college and did loads better. Don't do it. Nope, nope, nope. Listen to me. Don't. Do. It.

Textbook's worthless, only for practice problems. She's really bad at explaining things and already assumes you've taken calc. If you haven't, expect calculus at Richmond in general to be a tough course. Her office is always packed. She's funny, though.
Really good teacher. Class is very easy and if you put a little effort will get an A for sure

Compared to what I've heard about other Richmond Calc teachers, Wares seems to be the best. That said, I still thought the material was pretty difficult. Homework is online and pretty easy if you put time into it. Tests are pretty straightforward and final was comprehensive but same format as the tests. Wares is funny enough to keep it interesting.

Her personality is weirdly hilarious so it keeps you engaged in class which is great.  She sometimes makes things more confusing than need be, but she is ALWAYS willing to help you in her office hours which is great.  Plus she posts khan academy videos on blackboard that relate to each class- use them! Overall liked her, I'd recommend her!

One of the best professors I have ever met! She is so nice that always ends the class early while goes though all the important knowledge. And her tests is easy if you listen carefully on the class and do all the homework. Recommend her at all!
Wares is a very excited and enthusiastic teacher. Her tests are fairly easy and homework is optional. Make sure you print her powerpoint presentations and you are set for class.

Her class may seem difficult/ confusing at times, but she's very straightforward when it comes to her expectations for tests and homework. The online homework can be a bit of a pain on occasion. As for tests, she posts a practice test on Blackboard and as long as you understand the basic ideas, you'll be fine. I definitely recommend her
